$comment: Catppuccin Latte — the light mode of the one theme (DESIGN.md §3.10). Token names are the closed set in src/theme/tokens.ts. Palettes live here rather than in src/ because tui-check-boundary fails the build on any hex literal under src/, and routing around that gate with an allowlist would make the next literal easy. See themes/README.md for the AA deviations from stock Latte and why they exist.
